title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Peer STOP_SENDING Verification
verification_method: Focused raw loopback tests, requirement-home trace tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene for peer STOP_SENDING fatal handling.
scope: This verification covers the client reaction to a peer STOP_SENDING on an outstanding query stream and the resulting connection close. It does not verify missing expected STREAM FIN timeout policy or EDNS keepalive behavior.
preconditions: The DoQ foundation and minimal stream lifecycle slices exist.
Managed QUIC loopback support is available so the raw server can synthesize peer STOP_SENDING on a live query stream.
expected_result: The focused DoQ fatal-error and RFC 9250 requirement-home tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9250 artifacts, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: The DoQ adapter now proves a peer STOP_SENDING on the outstanding query stream is treated as a fatal protocol error. Missing expected STREAM FIN timeout policy, EDNS keepalive handling, and server-initiated bidirectional stream handling remain open.
